name: Bond USD0
oneLiner: bUSD0 is Usual's bond-leg wrapper of USD0, splitting deposited USD0 into a fixed-notional bond token plus a separate early-exit right redeemable at maturity.
collateral: Locked USD0 bond position backed by the Usual USD0 reserve stack; bUSD0 is the fixed-notional bond leg formerly known as USD0++
pegMechanism: Depositing 1 USD0 mints 1 bUSD0 plus 1 rt-bUSD0 early-exit right; before June 11, 2028 par redemption requires both tokens, while bUSD0 alone redeems 1:1 for USD0 at maturity and may trade below par before then

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Usual's official bUSD0 materials identify the token as a bond wrapper over USD0, while the USD0 technical documentation describes issuer or DAO-controlled minting and blacklist checks on the underlying token. A separate deployment-wide holder-freeze inventory for bUSD0 was not established, so the explicit Possible status is retained.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 access review

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: bUSD0 inherits USD0's multichain route surface. Usual documents USD0 and USUAL deployments across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and BNB Chain with Chainlink CCIP and LayerZero supporting unified liquidity, so the bridge route is scored as an external validated-network dependency.

mintAuthority.summary: bUSD0 is Usual's bond-maturity wrapper of USD0; depositing 1 USD0 mints 1 bUSD0 against locked USD0, which does not create base USD0 supply, so its mint authority is inherited from USD0 (usd0-usual). Wrapper upgrade is guarded by an 8-of-15 legacy Gnosis Safe.

controls.label: Usual bUSD0 bond-leg token
controls.capDescription: bUSD0 is minted/burned by the Usual bond contract against locked USD0 (1 USD0 in -> 1 bUSD0 + 1 rt-bUSD0 out, redeemable at maturity); this bond accounting cannot create or destroy base USD0 supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295204: mint(address,uint256) call reverted (no privileged mint function); totalSupply=526,811,371 USD0 locked; EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x65a7042460932a8e7b6aa9c765c2bae5f4535c22 (ProxyAdmin contract). ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xaada24358620d4638a2ee8788244c6f4b197ca16 (legacy Gnosis Safe: 15 owners, threshold 8, confirmed via getOwners() and getThreshold() on-chain).

controls.label: Inherited USD0 (Usual) issuer mint path
controls.evidence: Underlying USD0 supply is created via Usual's protocol-operated issuer mint authority against RWA collateral (issuer-direct-mint, concentrated-admin); bUSD0 locks USD0 and inherits that base mint authority.

review.evidence: bUSD0 (variantOf usd0-usual, variantKind bond-maturity) is a bond-leg wrapper whose supply tracks locked USD0. At Ethereum block 25295204: no privileged mint on wrapper (mint() reverts); EIP-1967 proxy admin chain: ProxyAdmin(0x65a704) -> legacy Gnosis Safe(0xaada24, 15 owners, threshold 8) confirmed via on-chain getOwners()/getThreshold() calls.
